name: Software Product Landscape
constraints: The existing vr.vercy.plmm identifier is reused and 0.1.0-legacy remains immutable.
PLMM owns landscape identity, scope, memberships, dependencies, completeness and impact-query results.
Product identity and internals remain external masters referenced through immutable pins.
Landscape dependencies connect memberships and pin both endpoint versions.
Unpinned or stale edges remain visible but are excluded from canonical answers.
Membership and dependency withdrawal uses non-destructive tombstones.
Every impact query declares start nodes, relation filter, depth, cycle policy and as-of time.
Every result exposes missing edges, stale sources, unknown memberships, confidence and coverage boundary.
An empty graph means zero observed coverage rather than zero impact.
Scenario or inferred edges never silently become authoritative observations.
